 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
3 08-11-2023 Heard Mr. Alok Kumar Alok, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner who happens to be husband of the complainant (O.P. No.2) is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 65 of 2018 wherein the cognizance has been taken under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the complainant (O.P. No.2) in the year 2017.

However, soon after the marriage, she was allegedly subjected to demand of dowry of Rs. 15 lac and,
on non-fulfillment of the same, she was tortured in various ways and finally ousted from her Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56032 of 2023(3) dt.08-11-2023 matrimonial home leading to the filing of the instant complaint case.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that admittedly the marriage was solemnized in the year 2017 and after such belated stage, the demand of dowry appears to be not reliable.

However,
irrespective of all the odds, the petitioner is still ready to keep the O.P. No.2 as his wife with full Md. Ezaz @ Ezaz Ahamd vs The State Of Bihar on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14466303/

sentences.text: 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the complainant submits across the Board that the reason behind the torture is the fact that the petitioner has solemnized second marriage.
However, if there is any chance of settlement, the O.P. No.2 is also ready to amicably settle the matter.
6. Considering the submissions made on behalf of the parties, let the matter be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre.

7. Re-notify this case on 20.12.2023 along with the report of the Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
